mapper.insert: INSERT INTO report (reporter_id, target_type, target_id, reason, status, created_at) VALUES (#{reporterId}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{reason}, 'RECEIVED', NOW())
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM report WHERE target_type = #{targetType} AND target_id = #{targetId}
mapper.select: select * from report r join member m on r.target_id = m.member_id order by r.created_at desc

choose.when: SELECT r.report_id, r.reporter_id, r.target_type, r.target_id, r.reason, r.status, r.created_at, c.content AS comment_content, DATE_FORMAT(c.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS comment_created_at, p.title AS project_title, cm.name AS member_name FROM report r LEFT JOIN comment c ON r.target_id = c.comment_id LEFT JOIN project p ON c.project_id = p.project_id LEFT JOIN member cm ON c.member_id = cm.member_id WHERE UPPER(r.target_type) = 'COMMENT' ORDER BY r.created_at DESC

SELECT r.report_id, r.reporter_id, r.target_type, r.target_id, r.reason, r.status, r.created_at, i.title AS talent_title, i.category AS talent_category, DATE_FORMAT(i.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS talent_created_at, im.name AS member_name FROM report r LEFT JOIN intro_post i ON r.target_id = i.post_id LEFT JOIN member im ON i.member_id = im.member_id WHERE UPPER(r.target_type) = 'POST' ORDER BY r.created_at DESC
choose.otherwise: SELECT r.report_id, r.reporter_id, r.target_type, r.target_id, r.reason, r.status, r.created_at, p.title AS project_title, p.category AS project_category, p.status AS project_status, DATE_FORMAT(p.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS project_created_at, m.name AS member_name FROM report r LEFT JOIN project p ON r.target_id = p.project_id LEFT JOIN member m ON p.owner_id = m.member_id WHERE UPPER(r.target_type) = UPPER(#{targetType}) ORDER BY r.created_at DESC
